stories.title: USA WNT — Day 2 Double-Header at Devon Park

stories.title: Texas Longhorns — 16 Days to Fall Opener, Honors Keep Coming

Torres (2026 D1Softball POY, .530 BA/16HR/56RBI from FSU) and Kavan (2x WCWS MOP, senior) lead a team 16 days from its Sept. 29 opener vs. Murray State at McCombs Field (6 PM CT, free). Three-peat: only UCLA 1988-90 and OU 2021-23 have done it.
